title: Priority SEO List
subtitle: From MetaHotels · albaharhotelandresort.com · from Search Console, GA4, a full crawl and live checks of the site and booking engine on 13 Oct · about 4 hours 10 minutes · Priority — do the full list; then Nice-to-Have items once all Priority lists are done
lead: **The single biggest issue: the site has no SEO plugin running.** Almost every title is a WordPress default, meta descriptions are gone and the sitemap Google has returns 404. The money searches ("hotels in fujairah", "resorts in fujairah") sit at positions 9–15, close to page one. **Timing matters:** November and December are the biggest months for direct bookings, so these fixes need to be live before the season starts.

warnings_top: **Do not change offers or prices.** Leave the pop-up, the offer pages and the FAQ price and discount answers exactly as they are until we send confirmed copy. Anything marked [CONFIRM] waits for the hotel. Do item A first: items D, F and I need it.

sections.title: Switch an SEO plugin back on
sections.why: No SEO plugin is active on the live site. All 157 crawled pages have no meta description, no share-preview tags, and titles fall back to "Page – Al Bahar Hotel & Resort". The sitemap Google has on file (sitemap_index.xml) returns 404. The site earned AED 36,541 from Google organic in the last 90 days (35 bookings), so this is the first fix.

ol: Plugins → Installed Plugins. If **Yoast SEO** is listed but inactive, tell MetaHotels before deleting anything (its data is what we import in step 3).
Plugins → Add New → install and activate **Rank Math SEO**. Run the Setup Wizard in **Advanced** mode. Site type: **Hotel / Local business**.

In the wizard, when it offers **Import from Yoast SEO**, tick everything and import. If it does not offer it: Rank Math → Status & Tools → Import & Export → Other Plugins → Yoast SEO → Import. This brings back the old titles and metas where they still exist in the database.

Rank Math → Dashboard → Modules: turn **on** Sitemap, Schema, Local SEO, Image SEO. Leave **Redirections off** (the site already uses the *Redirection* plugin under Tools → Redirection; keep all redirects in one place).
Rank Math → Titles & Meta → Global Meta: Separator `|`. Posts → Single Post Title: `%title%` (blog titles are already long). Pages → Single Page Title: `%title% | %sitename%`.
After Rank Math is active, delete the old file `/llms.txt` from the site root (File Manager) or ask MetaHotels to. It was written by Yoast and points to pages we are about to noindex.

blocks.p: If you cannot install plugins with your login, message MetaHotels straight away and continue with items C, E, G and H.

checks.description: Rank Math active with Sitemap, Schema, Local SEO and Image SEO modules on; Redirections module off

sections.title: Site identity + one clean Hotel schema
sections.why: Five schema blocks are printed on **every** page (Organization, LocalBusiness, Product, FAQPage, Hotel). The Product block gives the hotel a 5-star rating from 2 reviews "written by Al Bahar", which is self-serving review markup.

ol: Rank Math → Titles & Meta → Local SEO: Person or Company = **Organization**; Name = `Al Bahar Hotel & Resort`; URL = `https://albaharhotelandresort.com/`.
Add one new WPCode snippet (HTML, Site Wide Header, Conditional Logic: Page = Homepage) and paste this exactly (shortened in this test fixture):

blocks.code:
<script type="application/ld+json">
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Hotel","@id":"https://albaharhotelandresort.com/#hotel","name":"Al Bahar Hotel & Resort","alternateName":["Al Bahar Hotel and Resort Fujairah","فندق ومنتجع البحر"],"url":"https://albaharhotelandresort.com/","telephone":"+971 9 202 7000","checkinTime":"15:00","checkoutTime":"12:00"}
</script>

blocks.p: Check with Google’s Rich Results Test on the homepage and on one room page. Check-in 15:00 and check-out 12:00 are copied from the schema already live [CONFIRM].

blocks.p: **Hold, do not edit yet [CONFIRM]**: room amenity lists (every room, including Sea View rooms and both suites, shows "View - Marina View", "Apartment", "Large Terrace" and "43 inch Flat screen TV"); TV size (49" on the homepage, 43" on room pages); "377 rooms"; the pop-up "special winter offers"; FAQ "up to 25% off" and "AED 400 to AED 600".

sections.title: Titles, meta descriptions and H1s
sections.why: About 9 in 10 identified Google clicks are searches for the hotel’s own name. The non-brand money searches sit on page 1–2 without a matching title: "hotels in fujairah" (1,857 impressions, position 15.6), "resorts in fujairah" (1,230, 12.7), "fujairah hotels" (1,753, 9.4), "hotel in fujairah near beach" (674, 5.5).

blocks.p: Edit page → Rank Math box → Edit Snippet. Paste Title and Description exactly. H1: change the main heading widget in Elementor. One H1 per page; where a second heading repeats the H1 (room pages, blog posts), set the repeat to H2.
